title: AdministrativeBoundaryFeatureCollection
description: A standard GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Polygon/MultiPolygon boundaries for one level of Uganda's administrative hierarchy (region, district, city, county/municipality, subcounty/town_council/division and parish/ward — built bottom-up from UBOS's 2024/2025 polygons; see docs/DATA_QUALITY.md for the few units without a polygon). Geometry itself follows the GeoJSON spec (RFC 7946) as-is; this schema only constrains the `properties` object each feature carries, which links the polygon back to the corresponding AdministrativeUnit record in dist/uganda-locations.json. Coverage below district level is intentionally partial (subcounty ~57%, parish ~4%) — this file lists only the units a real source's geometry actually matched; consult dist/data-quality-report.json or docs/DATA_QUALITY.md for exact coverage, don't assume completeness.

id.description: Matches the id of the corresponding record in dist/uganda-locations.json (e.g. 'district:mbarara', 'region:western').

level.description: Present on county/subcounty-tier features (values: 'county', 'municipality', 'subcounty', 'town_council', 'division', 'parish', 'ward'), since one file mixes tiers. Absent on region/district/city features, where the file itself is already single-tier.

district_id.description: Present on county, subcounty-tier and parish-tier features only: the id of the nearest district/city ancestor (walking up through county where applicable), for filtering without a separate lookup.

region_id.description: Present on district-level features; null/absent on region-level features (a region has no parent region).

subregion_id.description: Present on district-level features; the cultural/traditional sub-region, see schema/administrative-unit.schema.json.

hdx_pcode.description: The unit's exact OCHA COD-AB P-code (UG + 1 digit region, +3 district, +2 county, +2 subcounty), or null where COD-AB's 2020 snapshot has no equivalent (e.g. Terego). Added at build time from the unit record's external_refs.hdx_pcode — see data/crosswalk/hdx-cod-ab-uga.csv.

ubos_code.description: The unit's code in UBOS's NPHC 2024 / BEC 2025 frame (district 3 digits, subcounty 6, parish 8) where UBOS has the same unit under a matching name — see data/crosswalk/ubos-2024.csv.

inferred.description: True when the polygon was inferred from the territorial rule (the only unmapped unit of its parent gets the parent's remaining land) rather than read from a source; see the feature's 'inference' note.

includes_water.description: True on island parishes whose land the land mask lacks: the polygon keeps its full legal outline, lake included, rather than being dropped.

area_km2.description: Land area of the polygon in km², computed at build time (district polygons are clipped to land, so lakes are excluded).

source_ids.description: References into data/sources.json. Absent on region-level features, which are derived from the district geometry rather than an independent source — see their 'source' property instead.

source.description: Present on region-level features only: a plain-text note that the geometry was dissolved from district-level features rather than sourced independently.

population.description: Present on district-level features only (null on region-level features). Same shape as the `population` property on AdministrativeUnit records — see schema/administrative-unit.schema.json — merged in at build time for direct choropleth-map use.
